control_statement: Is the person clearly informed that they are interacting with AI?
expected_evidence: Persistent or first-interaction notice and screenshot

control_statement: Are generated or manipulated outputs machine-readably marked?
expected_evidence: Standard, sample, detection method and export-retention test

control_statement: Is prior notice provided for emotion recognition or biometric categorisation?
expected_evidence: Notice screen, privacy notice and activation criteria

control_statement: Can deepfakes and relevant public-interest AI text be clearly disclosed?
expected_evidence: Visible label, publication workflow and editorial accountability

control_statement: Are SSO/MFA, least privilege and access review implemented?
expected_evidence: Access matrix, MFA configuration and review record

control_statement: Are admin, model and security configuration privileges segregated and controlled?
expected_evidence: PAM, approval, four-eyes check and admin logs

control_statement: Are data encrypted in transit and at rest with managed keys?
expected_evidence: TLS, storage encryption and KMS evidence

control_statement: Are sensitive inputs restricted with classification, minimisation and masking?
expected_evidence: DLP rules, user warning, masking test and exception approval

control_statement: Are entities, tenants, environments and knowledge bases isolated?
expected_evidence: Architecture, tenant-isolation and access-bypass tests

control_statement: Are retention and deletion configurable for prompts, files, outputs, vectors and logs?
expected_evidence: Retention settings, deletion test and backup treatment

control_statement: Is institutional data excluded from training or subject to enforceable opt-out?
expected_evidence: Contract, settings, API parameters and vendor evidence

control_statement: Are APIs, plugins, agent tools and outbound connections allowlisted and least-privileged?
expected_evidence: Interface inventory, service accounts, scopes and network policy

control_statement: Are prompt injection, malicious files, retrieval bypass and indirect instructions mitigated?
expected_evidence: Red-team test, scanning, inherited ACL and blocking evidence
applicability: Generative AI, RAG or agent systems

control_statement: Are sensitive data, malicious code, harmful content and prohibited-use outputs controlled?
expected_evidence: DLP, filters, sandboxing and test report

control_statement: Are user, time, I/O, model version, tool calls and admin actions logged?
expected_evidence: Log fields, integrity, access restrictions and retention

control_statement: Are human review, rejection, stop, override and escalation available?
expected_evidence: Workflow, stop control, RACI and exercise evidence

control_statement: Are accuracy, hallucination, repeatability and limits tested?
expected_evidence: Benchmark, thresholds, failure cases and review rule

control_statement: Are bias, discrimination and performance differences across groups tested?
expected_evidence: Representativeness, subgroup testing, thresholds and remediation

control_statement: Are capacity, redundancy, fail-safe, recovery and manual fallback provided?
expected_evidence: Architecture, BCP/DR test, RTO/RPO and fallback

control_statement: Are vulnerability, patching, detection, response and serious-incident processes implemented?
expected_evidence: Scan, patch SLA, alerts, exercise and reporting process

control_statement: Are model, prompt, knowledge base, plugin and security changes tested and approved?
expected_evidence: Version inventory, change record, regression test and rollback

control_statement: Are drift, misuse, control failure and emerging risks monitored?
expected_evidence: KPI/KRI, alerts, review and remediation tracking

control_statement: Is an inventory of models, components, data sources and subcontractors maintained?
expected_evidence: Component inventory, versions/SBOM, agreements and vendor evidence

control_statement: Can data be exported, access revoked, data deleted and the system safely retired?
expected_evidence: Exit test, deletion evidence, revoked interfaces and replacement plan

control_statement: Are architecture, purpose, versions, limits, tests, controls and instructions documented?
expected_evidence: Technical file, instructions, test pack and approvals
